correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed the monomial Gram block G_jk=(1+tau*j²)delta_jk+tau beta jk delta_|j-k|,m and strict positive pivots d_k=a_k-b_(k-m)^2/d_(k-m). Orthogonal coefficients in each residue chain alternate and have ascending magnitude ratio b_k/d_k. For L=(m+1)beta<=1, the displayed identity L(a_k-b_(k-m)L)-b_k=beta[(m+1)+tau k(m(k-1)-L²(k-m))]>0 establishes ratio<L inductively. Enestroem-Kakeya on the positive-coefficient transformed polynomial confines all nonzero roots strictly within L^(1/m). At n=m+1, the explicit polynomial z^(m+1)-tau beta(m+1)/(1+tau)z approaches the radius and escapes when L>1 and tau>1/(L-1). beta=0 gives monomials; m=1 supercritical beta is excluded by weight positivity. Independently reimplemented rational Gram orthogonality and coefficient-ratio checks for m=1..5, multiple beta,tau, degrees<=16; these finite cases supplement rather than prove the induction.
